= Flow Layout =

This is the original CSS layout, from the days where the Web was just a collections of text documents with links.
The flow layout is also the default layout for all elements, bar the table. 

Whitin the flow we can have Block elements and Inline elements.

=== The following applies to a writing mode like English, left->right and top->down. ===

== Blocks ==

You can think of the Block elements as the layout elements, the building blocks of a text document.
Blocks are also greedy, and take up all available space by default and do not tolarate other block elements next to them.
Their direction is from top to down.

By default a block element has a `width` of `auto`. 
Auto takes up all available space, after subtracting margins etc, 100% will take up all the space ignoring margins and will overflow if necessary.

== Inlines ==

Inline elements on the contrary do tolarate other elements around them, flow horizontally, and do not have any say on the vertical space. `margin-block-start` and `margin-block-end` have no effect on inline elements.
